flows.desc: One codebase, three targets: the script installs all 56 items into apps/example from the v0.1.0 tag with peers at Expo 57 pins and a dev-client-free graph, then proves the set runs from that single tree — the Android build and gallery boot, the web export/serve deep-link check, and the registry-meta assertions in one run; the physical-iPhone Expo Go half of this flow is human-observed in the gate steps, and the meta rows the cards render are the shipped declarations, not hand labels.

Every shipped source scanned for web-only constructs — DOM elements, iframes, document./window. access, hover-only classes without an active twin, raw lucide JSX — by executing the styling contract's own checks block against packages/registry/src and both emitted public/r trees, with an implanted-violation case proving the checker can fail; the human half is the click-not-hover, keyboard-reachable control check in Chrome.

Every one of the 56 shipped items demonstrated in loading, empty, error and populated states with interactive prop controls, on a real product surface (the /gallery route) — one detail screen per item behind a four-segment control, a stranger's bounded manual walk plus a generated Maestro flow that walks all 224 state sections cold against id-only selectors on the Android emulator, with the web leg agreeing over the static export and both engine trees proven to serve the identical set.

The PortalHost trap, re-derived onto the gallery: the script strips PortalHost from the root layout under an EXIT trap, and the DEVICE leg must fail on `context-popover-content` while the WEB leg of the same run stays green — a surface that renders in the browser but renders nothing on a phone, caught. If both legs pass during the trap, the gate is not real.

The appearance flip, observed where it has never been observed: adb `cmd uimode night yes/no` around cold gallery runs on Pixel_7_API_34 producing light/dark capture pairs sampled from the labeled scheme strip, the Chrome prefers-color-scheme emulation flip on the served web export, and the Settings flip on the Expo Go physical iPhone — every AI Elements surface and the surrounding chrome flip in the same frame, no stragglers, and the scheme is never held in library-local state.

Toggle the device to dark while a response is actively streaming: the script starts the conversation item's committed-fixture stream replay on the emulator, flips uimode to night mid-token via adb, and asserts every surface flips in the same frame — sampled from the scheme strip and the streaming bubble — while the stream keeps appending with no interruption, restart or dropped scroll pin, then flips back to light mid-stream and asserts the same.
